$Comment: The Great Turkey (the role Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey, and Harvest_Feast_Great_Turkey_HM on the hard way in), the Turkey Graveyard's boss. Both its fights' scripts find it through this group: to bind it when it rises without a spawn marker, to hold it through the fight, and to clear it away when the fight resets. No reputation names this group, and Martha's favor counts none of it. Add a role id here, written *<id>, if the Great Turkey gains another form. Each role id is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role, while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
